purpose: Determine whether RBI publishes the auction-method and weighted-average-price fields needed to qualify retail noncompetitive 91-day Treasury-bill acquisitions.

primary_sources.title: RBI Government Securities FAQ
primary_sources.relevant_rule: Noncompetitive allotments are at the weighted-average price/yield of successful competitive bids; retail participation is through an authorized aggregator/facilitator, including Retail Direct as stated in the auction notice.

sample.auction_notice_says_retail_route: RBI Retail Direct portal available for individuals; retail allocation capped at up to 5% of notified amount.
sample.ncb_price_basis: weighted-average successful competitive price/yield under RBI FAQ; do not substitute the cutoff in a multiple-price auction.

retrieval_and_integrity.review_method: Official RBI page text opened through the web research interface on 2026-11-06; the three direct RBI URLs above are retained.
retrieval_and_integrity.limitation: Local Invoke-WebRequest to the official host failed because the configured local proxy at 127.0.0.1:9 refused the connection. No attempt was made to bypass the configured network path. Web-rendered source text is not represented as hash-retained raw evidence.

decision_use.route_feasible: yes, per-auction notices can state method and full result releases publish weighted-average prices, auction acceptance and partial allotment fields.
remaining_work: Acquire and hash each official notice and full result for the Table 218 auction dates (or an authoritative official bulk export).
Reconcile each notice/result pair to Table 218 auction and issue dates, tenor, notified/accepted amounts and price/yield fields.
Classify eligible NCB price using the contemporaneous rule and method; preserve rows without an exact pair as blocked.
Model subscription limits, partial allotment, minimum lot, settlement, maturity, reinvestment, fees, taxes and uninvested cash.
